text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: Let's see, the next menu item is—

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry... 
It seems I wasn't minding my footing...

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Still, hmm... 
No matter how bad the footing is, I almost 
never stumble like that...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps due to fatigue, Daring Tact's 
sharp instincts seem dulled. 
It might be best to reconsider her 
schedule.
